name: SpecDown
subtitle: Markdown & Mermaid viewer
promotional_text: Open any Markdown file and see it beautifully rendered — with live Mermaid diagrams, tables, highlighted code and Dark Mode. Free, private, no account.
description:
SpecDown is a fast, clean viewer for Markdown files — built for specs, design docs, READMEs and notes that include diagrams.

Open a file from the Files app, iCloud Drive, or any app's share sheet, and SpecDown renders it instantly: headings, lists, tables, links, images and syntax-highlighted code — plus Mermaid diagrams drawn right in the document.

MERMAID DIAGRAMS, RENDERED LIVE
• Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams, Gantt charts and more
• Tap a diagram to open it fullscreen, then zoom and pan
• Diagrams follow your light or dark appearance

MADE FOR READING TECHNICAL DOCS
• Clean typography for long documents
• Tables and code blocks with syntax highlighting
• Table of contents to jump between sections
• Switch to the raw Markdown source at any time
• Open several documents in tabs

OPEN FILES YOUR WAY
• Browse the Files app, including iCloud Drive
• Open With… and the share sheet from other apps
• Open a Markdown file from a web or GitHub link
• Bookmarks and recent files to get back quickly

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Adaptive layout with an iPad sidebar
• Light and Dark Mode
• Choose from several alternate app icons

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
SpecDown has no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking. Your documents stay on your device; the app only goes online when you open a link or a document that references web images.
